name: Kotani Hirohiko
source:
The psychology teacher. A knowledgeable but somewhat powerless authority figure.
Calm, observant, and weary. He possesses key information about the bullying incident but was unable to stop it, carrying guilt and a physical reminder (the bruise).
Before wedding, known as Nagase Hirohiko.
